components.css: .ds-offer{padding:24px 24px 16px;border-radius:24px;background:#1f4d3a;color:#e7f1ec;font-family:"Manrope Variable",sans-serif}.ds-offer-label{display:inline-flex;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid currentColor;border-radius:999px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.4}.ds-offer h3{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:28px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.3}.ds-offer p{margin:12px 0 0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}.ds-offer-forest{margin-top:22px;border-radius:18px;aspect-ratio:2.4;background:#022e24 url("/assets/forest2d/scenarios.webp") center/cover}.ds-offer-action{display:flex;width:100%;min-height:50px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:12px 0 0;border:0;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}.ds-offer-action span{display:grid;width:32px;height:32px;place-items:center;border-radius:50%;background:#e7f1ec;color:#022e24;transition:transform 180ms ease}.ds-offer-action:hover span{transform:rotate(45deg)}.ds-offer-action:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #4f8f75;outline-offset:5px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-offer-action span{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Scope: the public `/` landing only. This records the user's selected composition and forest palette; it does not redefine the corporate workspace, gameplay, or existing authentication UI. Implementation authority is `frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.jsx` and `frontend/src/pages/landing-gateway.css`.

The landing is calm, spacious, and welcoming. Bold sans-serif promises meet italic literary headings, while existing illustrated forests give the page a consistent setting. Light sections provide breathing room between immersive forest sections. The metaphor names this already approved direction rather than introducing a new identity.
keyCharacteristics: Alternating forest and pale paper surfaces.
Bold Manrope paired with italic Literata.
Rounded controls and broad landscape crops.

rules.name: The Readable Forest Rule
rules.body: Forest artwork supports the text; maintain the existing dark overlays and at least 4.5:1 contrast for normal text.

dos: Do apply this visual world only to the public landing.
Do preserve the selected section sequence, owl, paired CTAs, team portraits, and footer.
Do maintain normal-text contrast, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do check the landing at 1440, 768, 390, and 320px widths after visual changes.
donts: Don't spread these landing tokens into the corporate app or existing authentication components.
Don't replace the team portraits with decorative forest crops.
Don't lighten the business card without rechecking its paper-text contrast.
Don't collapse the mobile how-to heading into a joined word when removing its desktop break.
